$comment: Maps Figma variable collections onto design token groups. Run `npm run tokens:check` to list collection names discovered in the Figma file; add any unmapped ones here. `group` is the key path in tokens.json (dots allowed). `unit` appends a CSS unit to numeric values.
$fileKeyComment: Set to the Figma file key of the Scootorama token library (or pass FIGMA_FILE_KEY). Leave empty until a Figma library exists.
$prefixesComment: Used when importing a flat Dev Mode export (get_variable_defs), which has no collection metadata. Longest matching prefix wins; the prefix is stripped from the token path. `group` may be a dotted path. `font/family/` is ignored because the repo stores full CSS font stacks while Figma stores family names; `Space-N` is ignored as a legacy numeric duplicate of the semantic `spacing/*` scale.
$aliasesComment: Figma variable name -> full token path in tokens.json. Use where Figma's naming or nesting differs from the repo's. Every entry here is a naming divergence worth fixing at the source; treat this list as debt, not as design.
